newsitem.title: JAPAN: ANA to raise int'l capacity by 25 pct in 97/98.
newsitem.headline: ANA to raise int'l capacity by 25 pct in 97/98.

text.p: All Nippon Airways Co Ltd (ANA) said on Wednesday that it plans to increase its international passenger capacity by more than 25 percent in the next business year starting in April.
The company said in a statement: "The carrier plans to continue its rapid international expansion for a third consecutive year."
It said that its capacity for flying international passengers rose 24 percent in 1995/96 business year, and expects growth of 23 percent in 1996/97.
"ANA hopes for major growth in its operations to the United States," it said.
ANA also expects total passengers in the next business year to set a record high of 40.9 million, it said.
Of the total, ANA predicted that it would carry a record 37.8 million passengers on its domestic network.
ANA is Japan's largest carrier of domestic flights.
